title: 渠道广告后的贡献利润
context: 电商＋财务联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 2025年线上订单归因会话渠道，净销售、毛利减广告支出为广告后贡献；未分摊管理、人力或配送费用；输出贡献率；按广告后贡献金额降序、渠道编号升序排列。
commonError: 广告后毛利不等于公司净利润。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT s.source_id,SUM(o.net_cents) net,SUM(o.net_cents-o.cost_cents) gross FROM v_order_net o JOIN customer_sessions s ON s.session_id=o.session_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.source_id), b AS (SELECT source_id,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY source_id) SELECT t.source_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(b.spend,0) spend_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0) contribution_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0))/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) contribution_pct FROM traffic_sources t LEFT JOIN a ON a.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.source_id=t.source_id ORDER BY contribution_cents DESC,t.source_id
